final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT translink, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM advancedbehavior GROUP BY translink), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.translink, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt as diff FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_of_second_column, AVG(diff) as average_of_third_column FROM step3
